svg.title: Player one: who I am
svg.desc: Senior software engineer with 10+ years across the full software development life cycle. Signature numbers: 10+ years; 50+ AWS microservices on a platform he helped build and support; a >3,000-line Python backend refactored to ~1,000 lines with +20% performance; PyTest coverage kept above 85% on new code; 5 domains (finance, healthcare, retail, pharma, insurance); led backend teams at Freddie Mac and Humana and API development at CVS Health. A spinning wireframe gear nods to his mechanical engineering degree: from gears to graphs.

text.tspan: Now: FastAPI microservices on AWS EKS/ECS serving ML
forecasting models at Freddie Mac. Backend, cloud, AI-driven.
